mask_all.risk: includes known channel9 failure in 5m groups

mask_hard_bad_by_group.purpose: simulate removing only the known bad channel where it occurred
mask_hard_bad_by_group.risk: group-specific masking can encode distance-specific QC decisions and should not be used as a final modeling shortcut

mask_no_ch9_global.purpose: fair modeling-oriented mask that removes channel9 everywhere
mask_no_ch9_global.risk: removes potentially useful non-5m channel9 information to avoid 5m-specific leakage

mask_no_ch9_ch5_global.purpose: conservative comparison excluding confirmed channel9 risk and suspected channel5 risk
mask_no_ch9_ch5_global.risk: may discard useful signal if channel5 is not actually faulty

mask_healthy_candidate.purpose: default healthy-channel candidate mask; currently equivalent to mask_no_ch9_ch5_global
mask_healthy_candidate.risk: does not automatically infer any additional suspect channels
